answer: The cipher holds work receipts rather than names, so the falcon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the trellis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit.
